create_scheduler: create a ScoreSdeVeScheduler instance with custom sigma_min, sigma_max, and snr parameters for variance exploding SDE diffusion
set_timesteps: set the continuous timesteps for the diffusion chain by calling set_timesteps with the number of inference steps
set_sigmas: set the noise scales for the diffusion chain by calling set_sigmas with custom sigma_min and sigma_max values
step_pred: predict the previous timestep sample by reversing the SDE using step_pred with model output and current sample
step_correct: correct the predicted sample using step_correct with model output to refine the diffusion sample iteratively
